messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Who is considered the manufacturer after a substantial modification of machinery?

Facts:
[0] natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification — hasObligation — shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Article 10 (shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in article 10) [condition: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery] [REG, Art. 18]
[1] substantial modification — definedAs — a modification of machinery or a related product (a modification of machinery or a related product) [condition: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer] [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[2] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use — becomesManufacturer — shall not be considered to be a manufacturer (shall not be considered to be a manufacturer) [condition: for his or her own use] [REG, Art. 18]
[3] any natural or legal person who places on the market or puts into service machinery — becomesManufacturer — shall be considered a manufacturer (shall be considered a manufacturer) [condition: In the absence of a manufacturer as defined above] [DIR, Art. 2]
[4] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — bears at least the designation of the partly completed machinery (bears at least the designation of the partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 11(5)]
[5] manufacturer — definedAs — means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery (means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery) [condition: under his own name or trademark or for his own use] [DIR, Art. 2]
[6] manufacturer — becomesManufacturer — puts those products into service for its own use (puts those products into service for its own use) [condition: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation] [REG, Art. 3(18)]
[7] the manufacturer — hasObligation — the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by the manufacturer (the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by the manufacturer) [condition: Where the machinery or related products cannot be assembled in the manufacturer’s premises] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.3]
[8] manufacturer — becomesManufacturer — markets those products under its name or trademark (markets those products under its name or trademark) [condition: manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured] [REG, Art. 3(18)]
[9] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — Manufacturers shall indicate their name (manufacturers shall indicate their name) [condition: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in a document accompanying the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(6)]
[10] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary (shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary) [condition: Manufacturers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation] [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[11] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art (ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art) [DIR, Annex IX]
[12] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — Manufacturers shall ensure that procedures are in place (manufacturers shall ensure that procedures are in place) [condition: for partly completed machinery that is part of a series production] [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[13] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — Adequate account shall be taken of changes in the production process (adequate account shall be taken of changes in the production process) [condition: changes in the harmonised standards or other technical specifications, by reference to which the conformity is declared or verified] [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[14] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — determine the limits of the machinery (determine the limits of the machinery) [DIR, Annex I]
[15] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[16] manufacturer applying internal production control — hasObligation — it shall design and construct the machinery or related product (it shall design and construct the machinery or related product) [condition: if a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a)] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[17] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer (provide the appropriate guard(s)) [condition: where necessary] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.2.1]
[18] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use — hasObligation — shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10 (shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in article 10) [condition: for his or her own use] [REG, Art. 18]
[19] manufacturer — hasObligation — a description of the means used by the manufacturer during the production (a description of the means used by the manufacturer during the production of the partly completed machinery) [REG, Annex IV, Part B]
[20] machinery or related product substantially modified — requiresProcedure — conformity assessment procedure as provided in Article 25 (2), (3) and (4) (conformity assessment procedure as provided in article 25 (2), (3) and (4)) [REG, Art. 18]
[21] manufacturer — hasObligation — under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer (under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer) [REG, Annex V, Part B, point 3]
[22] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[23] manufacturers — hasObligation — immediately take the corrective actions necessary (immediately take the corrective actions necessary) [condition: where manufacturers consider or have reason to believe that machinery or a related product is not in conformity with this Regulation] [REG, Art. 10(9)]
[24] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that the manufacturer has drawn up (shall ensure that the manufacturer has drawn up) [condition: Before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[25] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[26] manufacturer of the machinery or related product — hasObligation — the appropriate guard(s) shall be provided (the appropriate guard(s) shall be provided) [condition: Where necessary] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.2.1]
[27] importer or distributor — becomesManufacturer — where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies a product already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the applicable requirements might be affected ("") [condition: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies a product already placed on the market in such a way that compliance with the applicable requirements might be affected] [REG, Art. 17]
[28] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — hasObligation — shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that (shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that) [condition: before placing it on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[29] manufacturer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — the relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B is prepared (the relevant technical documentation described in annex vii, part b is prepared) [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[30] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — makes a declaration of incorporation (makes a declaration of incorporation) [condition: stating that it is to be incorporated into machinery or assembled with other partly completed machinery to form machinery] [DIR, Art. 6(2)]
[31] person who carries out substantial modification — hasObligation — ensure and declare on its sole responsibility (ensure and declare on its sole responsibility) [REG, Art. 18]
[32] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities (shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[33] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall immediately inform the competent national authorities (shall immediately inform the competent national authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[34] importers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall place only compliant partly completed machinery (shall place only compliant partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 14(1)]
[35] manufacturer — hasObligation — mark on the partly completed machinery (mark on the partly completed machinery) [condition: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[36] manufacturers — hasObligation — Manufacturers shall ensure (manufacturers shall ensure that the machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[37] distributor of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities (shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market surveillance authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 16(3)]
[38] manufacturers or installers — hasObligation — should be retained and kept with the machine documentation (should be retained and kept with the machine documentation) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 149]
[39] manufacturer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared (assembly instructions described in annex vi are prepared) [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[40] manufacturers — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(1)]
[41] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed (shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[42] importers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — immediately take the corrective actions necessary (immediately take the corrective actions necessary) [condition: Importers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation] [REG, Art. 14(6)]
[43] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall draw up the EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article 22 (shall draw up the eu declaration of incorporation in accordance with article 22) [condition: Where compliance of partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated in the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[44] distributors of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall make sure that the corrective actions (shall make sure that the corrective actions) [condition: who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have made available on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation] [REG, Art. 16(5)]
[45] distributors — hasObligation — the manufacturer and the importer have complied with the requirements (manufacturer and importer have complied with Article 10(5), (6) and Article 13(3)) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[46] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B (eu declaration of incorporation set out in annex v, part b) [condition: or, alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine readable code] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[47] manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 — hasObligation — shall apply the internal production control procedure (shall apply the internal production control procedure) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I] [REG, Art. 25(4)]
[48] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — envisage not only the intended use (envisage not only the intended use) [condition: when designing and constructing machinery and drafting the instructions] [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.2]
[49] operator — definedAs — the person or persons installing, operating, adjusting, maintaining, cleaning, repairing or moving machinery (the person or persons installing, operating, adjusting, maintaining, cleaning, repairing or moving machinery) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.1]

response.text: {"kind":"text","value":"The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations under Article 10, but only if the modification affects the safety of machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery. A non-professional user who modifies machinery for his or her own use is not considered a manufacturer.","text":"Under Article 18 of the Regulation, the person who carries out a substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations in Article 10, if the modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery. A non-professional user modifying machinery for his or her own use is not considered a manufacturer and is not subject to those obligations. Article 3(16) defines a substantial modification as one not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer. Article 17 also makes an importer or distributor a manufacturer if it modifies a product already placed on the market in a way that might affect compliance.","used":[0,1,2,18,27]}
